notes: This template is deliberately non-empirical and cannot certify a Gaze-in-the-Wild copy.
Populate every distributed LabelData and ProcessData MATLAB path, SHA-256 digest, and byte size from one authoritative reviewed snapshot.
Bind every label stream to an audited participant ID, trial/task ID, labeller ID, and ProcessData path.
Verify analysis-use permission separately from raw-data redistribution permission.
Do not mark coordinate_unit_verified or pixel_kinematics_compatible until the ETG.POR coordinate basis has been independently verified.
Keep the published 120 Hz hardware rate separate from the cadence inferred from each LabelData.T stream.
